dedupe_keys.name: monitored occupant presence and actions in a university office area in vienna 2013

description: This dataset gives one year of monitored occupant presence and behaviour, with indoor and outdoor environmental data, for an office area of about 200 square metres in a university building in Vienna, from 1 January to 31 December 2013. It was deposited on figshare on 13 August 2019 by Ardeshir Mahdavi, Farhang Tahmasebi, Matthias Schuss and a co-author named Berger; the metadata does not name an institution. Variables are workstation presence, window state, light state, equipment power, indoor air temperature and relative humidity at 15-minute intervals, and global radiation, outdoor air temperature and humidity, wind speed and wind direction hourly. Coverage is one office area for one year. Access: figshare. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: a small office and one year. Simulation uses: training and validating occupancy, window and lighting behaviour models for building energy simulation. Related records: the Philadelphia office human-building interaction data and ROBOD.
name: Monitored occupant presence and actions in a university office area in Vienna (2013)
